description: Process a holds a dynaset over rows 1-8 positioned on row 5 and a clone positioned on row 5 by FindFirst, and reads fields, Bookmark, BOF, EOF and EditMode of both. Process b deletes row 5 and reinserts a row with the identical key and values; a reads the same properties of both, then Move 0 on both. Process b then deletes it again and reinserts it with a different N, V and S; a reads again, then Requery on the dynaset and reads. Asks what the retained cursors and their bookmarks report after delete/reinsert of one key.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
